title: 17 waste materials tested to make stronger, lower-carbon cement building products
summary_full: A James Dyson Award project explores using waste for construction materials.  Recycled aggregates like eggshells and glass replace conventional materials in cement.  This approach reduces reliance on newly extracted natural resources.  The project aims to create thinner, stronger cement boards and tiles.  Further testing will assess durability and recycling potential for these innovative products.
